findings.issue: The partial-write test checks only the words 'playlist ID' in nextStep. The actual result UI never displays receipt.ids.playlistId or receipt.ids.videoId, so users cannot follow the exact-ID read-back instructions after PARTIAL_PLAYLIST_CREATED. Execute the served renderer and assert that the returned IDs are visible.

summary: Found and fixed one medium-severity acceptance gap: partial-write receipts instructed users to read back an exact playlist ID without displaying the returned playlist/video IDs. The result UI now displays escaped IDs, protected by an HTTP-to-renderer regression that failed before the fix; all 226 tests, lint, and coverage pass, and a 390px browser flow verified candidate selection, saving, duplicate handling, and partial-write read-back against the test provider. No needs-human findings remain.
